funnel.question: Reach: can AI crawlers and fetchers get in?
Read: does the content exist without JavaScript?
Quote: can a machine lift a clean fact?
Trust: is it fresh, corroborated, unambiguous?
Retain: does the arriving visitor stay?

findings.title: No structured data anywhere on sampled pages
findings.mechanism: Schema markup is how a machine picks the exact fact out of the page without guessing (appendix concepts A and C).
findings.evidence: 0 JSON-LD blocks and no microdata across 1 pages (https://example.com/).

suggested_action.summary: Add JSON-LD to every page: Organization (with name, url, logo, sameAs) sitewide, plus the type matching each page (Product with Offer, FAQPage, Article, LocalBusiness).

findings.title: Homepage has very little machine-readable text
findings.mechanism: A machine can only quote what it can read as text (appendix concept C).
findings.evidence: Only 21 words of visible text in the raw HTML of https://example.com/.

suggested_action.summary: State plainly in HTML text who the brand is, what it offers, for whom, and where. Every fact that matters must exist as text, not only inside images or video.

findings.title: Homepage offers almost no paths deeper into the site
findings.mechanism: A single-exit page converts an interested visitor into a bounce statistic.
findings.evidence: No nav element links and fewer than 5 total links found in homepage markup.

suggested_action.summary: Add a simple persistent navigation covering the pages that answer buyer questions: product or services, pricing, about, contact.

findings.title: Probe failed: 'How do I contact them?' has no extractable answer
findings.mechanism: A fact that is only in a form or an image cannot be quoted into an answer (appendix concept C).
findings.evidence: No phone number, email address, or PostalAddress or ContactPoint schema found in the text of 1 sampled pages. Contact details may exist only inside images, JavaScript widgets, or forms.

suggested_action.summary: Publish contact details as selectable HTML text on a /contact page and mirror them in ContactPoint or LocalBusiness JSON-LD.

findings.title: Probe failed: 'Who is behind this brand?' has no extractable answer
findings.mechanism: Background facts drive trust in both assistants and humans; when absent, assistants fill the gap from third-party sources or say nothing.
findings.evidence: No about page was discoverable from homepage navigation or the sitemap sample, and no founding or team facts appear in sampled text.

suggested_action.summary: Add an /about page stating in plain text who runs the brand, since when, where, and what makes it different; link it from the main navigation.

findings.title: No usable XML sitemap found
findings.mechanism: Sitemaps are how crawlers find pages that navigation does not surface, and lastmod is a freshness signal.
findings.evidence: Tried https://example.com/sitemap.xml -> HTTP 404; robots.txt declares a sitemap: False.

suggested_action.summary: Publish /sitemap.xml with canonical URLs and lastmod dates, and declare it in robots.txt with a Sitemap: line.

findings.title: No machine-readable freshness signal anywhere
findings.mechanism: Systems prefer sources they can prove are current; with no dates they must assume the worst or trust a fresher competitor.
findings.evidence: No datePublished or dateModified in structured data and no lastmod dates in the sitemap across 1 sampled pages.

suggested_action.summary: Emit dateModified in Article or WebPage JSON-LD and lastmod in the sitemap, updated by the build pipeline, so machines can see the content is maintained.

findings.title: Site is an island: no links to any off-site brand profile
findings.mechanism: A claim that exists in exactly one place is fragile; corroboration across independent sources is what makes machines repeat it (appendix concept D).
findings.evidence: No links to LinkedIn, Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase, GitHub or social profiles anywhere in sampled pages, and no sameAs in schema.

suggested_action.summary: Link official profiles in the footer and declare them in Organization sameAs. Then keep name, description and address identical across those profiles.

proactive_recommendations.summary: The homepage has no meta description. Add a 150 to 160 character summary stating what the brand is and for whom; assistants and search previews reuse it verbatim.

No FAQ content or FAQPage schema found. Publishing the 10 questions customers actually ask, each answered in 2 to 4 sentences with FAQPage JSON-LD, creates ready-made citation targets shaped exactly like assistant queries.
No robots.txt found (HTTP 404). Crawlers default to full access, so nothing is blocked, but adding one with a Sitemap line gives crawlers an explicit map and an explicit welcome.

No /llms.txt. This is optional: no major AI provider has confirmed using it, so treat it as a cheap, low-risk curated index for agent tooling, not a fix for visibility problems. Prioritize the actual findings first.
No Open Graph tags on the homepage. Add og:site_name, og:title, og:description and og:image; they are read by far more systems than social networks alone and reinforce the brand entity.
